acceptance.feedback_coverage: Keep separate supplied-state and naturally generated posterior coverage; enumerate the complete registered tape support and preserve each terminal outcome and original denominator.
acceptance.mechanism_attribution: Benefits over fixed/greedy/error controls are generic information/planning/state-objective benefits. Equality with same-objective control is correctness, not NDU-exclusive advantage.
acceptance.native_same_objective: All original-native dynamic values, feasible candidates and chosen actions equal the independently encoded exact oracle and same-objective control.
acceptance.net_gain: This finite-state suite does not establish physical net benefit; it only prepares source-bound witnesses for separately budgeted real execution.
acceptance.numeric_preference: Count numeric changes and action changes independently, with unchanged feasibility and strictly positive external-objective regret where actions differ.

boundary_grid.rationale: Complete 1/64 belief mesh and five consecutive resource levels around the 12-unit cost of two direct requests. This resolves the independently derived retain/switch boundary without choosing favorable latency observations.

development_disclosure: An earlier complete 1080-state coarse reference grid changed numeric preference values but not preference actions. A separately declared complete 325-state analytic boundary reference sweep found six preference action reversals; the registered boundary expands the whole mesh to both symmetric requests and all environments, not just those six outcomes. Neither development sweep ran native latency. Their files remain retained as development evidence.
fixed_sufficient_definition: Registered fixed action zero, including its declared feasibility fallback, has the same full conditional recursive objective value as the independent oracle; matching only the current action is insufficient.
native_requirement: Both dynamic and fixed-preference NDU run every Bellman backup on each distinct registered public state; duplicate state memberships refer to the same retained run. No oracle results or realized future observations are passed to native search.

natural_support.scope: Exhaust all request/signal tapes, derive posterior from the declared initial prior and public history, and execute declared cache transitions along the reference policy. Alternate policies are compared at the same observation. This is model execution, not physical latency.

purpose: Finite-state mechanism coverage after the unchanged v1 episode campaign; no native latency selection and no production or exclusive-gain claim.
witness_rule: Retain every changed state identity and every no-change result. For later physical confirmation select the lexicographically first state per mechanism and environment, before observing physical latency; report complete coverage counts independently of the witness sample.
